name: khfagy
description: The safety net for Claude Code and for teams: undo any change Claude made, secret shields, project fence, destructive-command guard, enforced team policies, audit log with CSV export, Slack/Teams/Telegram alerts, token budget, review mode and reports. Available in 25 languages.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language: en, zh, hi, es, ar, fr, bn, pt, ru, ur, id, de, ja, tr, ko, vi, it, fa, th, pl, nl, uk, ms, ta, sw

theme.title: Navy theme
theme.description: Apply the bright navy look in the desktop and mobile apps

guardPrompts.title: Scan prompts for secrets
guardPrompts.description: Stop a message from being sent when it contains an API key, token or private key

guardSecrets.title: Protect secret files from edits
guardSecrets.description: Block edits to .env files, private keys and credential files

guardReads.title: Protect secret files from reading
guardReads.description: Block Claude from reading .env files, private keys and credential files

guardCommands.title: Block destructive commands
guardCommands.description: Block rm -rf on root or home, force pushes, disk wipes and DROP DATABASE

protectedPaths.title: Extra protected files
protectedPaths.description: Comma-separated: a file name, a folder ending in /, or *.ext. Example: secrets/, *.sqlite, config/prod.json

blockedCommands.title: Extra blocked commands
blockedCommands.description: Comma-separated text that blocks any shell command containing it. Example: terraform destroy, kubectl delete

guardOutputs.title: Hide secrets in tool output
guardOutputs.description: Withhold a command's output or a file's text from Claude when it contains an API key, token or private key

guardProjectFence.title: Project fence
guardProjectFence.description: Block edits outside the project folder (temp folders and .claude folders stay allowed)

allowedPaths.title: Allowed folders
allowedPaths.description: Comma-separated folders outside the project that Claude may edit. Example: D:/shared/config, C:/work/lib

timeMachine.title: Time machine
timeMachine.description: Keep each file as it was before Claude changed it, so /khfagy undo can restore it

dailyTokenBudget.title: Daily token budget
dailyTokenBudget.description: Warn at 80% and 100% of this many tokens a day. 0 turns it off.

budgetLock.title: Stop at budget
budgetLock.description: Stop sending messages once the daily token budget is used up

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Record every tool call and every block, by day, under ~/.claude/khfagy/audit (/khfagy audit exports CSV)

alertWebhook.title: Alert webhook
alertWebhook.description: Slack, Teams, Discord or Telegram (https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage?chat_id=<id>) webhook to notify when a guard blocks something

soundOnDone.title: Sound when a long turn finishes
soundOnDone.description: Play a short chime when a turn of 15 seconds or more ends

slowTurnSeconds.title: Slow turn alert (seconds)
slowTurnSeconds.description: Show a toast when a turn takes longer than this. 0 turns it off.
